search_text: published ZDI-16-442 ZDI-CAN-3510 Oracle Glassfish PartItem Arbitrary File Upload Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2016-07-21 CVE-2016-3607 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2016-3607 7.5 ['Oracle'] ['Glassfish Server'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Oracle Glassfish Server. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The PartItem class allows remote attackers to write to arbitrary files via a NULL byte in a file name in a serialized instance, when used in conjunction with a specific version of Oracle Java. An attacker could leverage this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code under the context of the process. Oracle has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: Oracle Glassfish PartItem Arbitrary File Upload Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Oracle Glassfish Server. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The PartItem class allows remote attackers to write to arbitrary files via a NULL byte in a file name in a serialized instance, when used in conjunction with a specific version of Oracle Java. An attacker could leverage this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code under the context of the process.
